title: Clearer Invoice Generation Summary
description: The invoice generation page now shows stats in 3 separate cards for better clarity.
details: Split summary into 3 cards: total/generated/open count, generated totals (net/tax/gross), and open totals (net)
Shows company name from invoice settings in sidebar
Fixed last login timestamp not being recorded for users

title: Search Invoices by Number
description: Global search in the sidebar now finds invoices by their invoice number.
details: Added invoice number search to the global search bar
Invoice results link directly to the invoice detail page

title: Fix Invoice Export Summary Totals
description: Net, tax, and gross totals on the invoice export page were inconsistent when ungenerated invoices were present.
details: Fixed net+tax not equaling gross in summary bar (ungenerated invoices inflated net but not gross)
Added 'Ungenerated (net)' indicator showing how much of the total is not yet finalized

title: Fix Invite Links Using Localhost Domain
description: Invite and password reset links contained localhost:5173 instead of the actual production domain, making them unusable.
details: Derive base URL from request Origin header instead of hardcoded localhost fallback
Fixes invite links, password reset links, and pending invitation URLs

title: Customer VAT ID with HubSpot Sync
description: Optional VAT ID field on customers, synced from HubSpot and displayed on invoices and ZUGFeRD XML.
details: New VAT ID field on customer detail page, editable inline
HubSpot sync pulls vatid property (does not overwrite manual entries when empty)
VAT ID shown on invoice PDF in customer address block
ZUGFeRD XML includes buyer tax registration from customer VAT ID

title: Fix Voided Invoices Blocking Re-generation
description: Voided invoices and storno credit notes appeared on the invoice generation page and in revenue forecasts, preventing re-invoicing and inflating totals.
details: Exclude voided invoices and storno documents from invoice generation preview
Exclude storno documents from revenue and recognition forecast queries
Voided contracts now appear as 'ungenerated' and can be re-invoiced

title: Fix Storno and Invoice Detail Navigation Links
description: Links between voided invoices and their storno credit notes pointed to incorrect URLs.
details: Fix storno/original invoice links to use correct route path

title: Fix MCP OAuth for Claude Desktop Connection
description: Claude Desktop could not authenticate because it sends a metadata document URL as client_id (per MCP OAuth spec), which django-oauth-toolkit rejected as unknown.
details: Custom authorize view resolves URL-based client_id by fetching client metadata and auto-registering
Supports MCP client_id_metadata_document flow (Claude sends https://claude.ai/oauth/mcp-oauth-client-metadata)
Auto-registered clients are cached — subsequent connections skip the metadata fetch

title: Invoice Voiding with Storno (Credit Note) Documents
description: Voiding a finalized or sent invoice now generates a Storno document (credit note) with its own number sequence, allowing proper accounting correction and re-invoicing of the same billing period.
details: Void finalized and sent invoices — creates a Storno credit note with copied financial data
Separate Storno number scheme (configurable pattern, default S-{YYYY}-{NNNN}) in invoice settings
Storno PDF generated automatically with reference to original invoice and void reason
Voided invoices link to their Storno document and vice versa in the detail view
Storno documents shown with distinct badge in invoice list and detail views
Fixed duplicate prevention: voided invoices no longer block re-generation for the same period

title: Fix MCP OAuth Discovery for Claude Desktop
description: Claude Desktop could not connect to the MCP server because the required Protected Resource Metadata endpoint (RFC 9728) was missing. The server only had Authorization Server Metadata (RFC 8414), but MCP clients need the Protected Resource Metadata to discover the authorization server.
details: Add /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource endpoint (RFC 9728) for MCP client discovery
Add /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp sub-path variant (tried first by clients)
Add middleware to include resource_metadata and scope in WWW-Authenticate header on 401
Fix MCP config URL: /mcp not /mcp/ (trailing slash returned 404)

title: MCP Settings UI, OAuth Scope Checks & HubSpot Country Fix
description: New API (MCP) settings tab with connection setup and tool overview, OAuth scope enforcement on MCP write operations, and corrected HubSpot country property mapping.
details: New API tab in Integration Settings with MCP connection config, read-only config, and available tools overview
Advanced section shows OAuth endpoint URLs for manual configuration
MCP write tools now enforce OAuth scope checks — read-only tokens are rejected for mutations
HubSpot sync uses country_list property instead of deprecated country field

title: Pro-rate Last Billing Period When Contract Ends Early
description: When a contract's end date falls before the next billing cycle, the last billing event is now pro-rated to cover only the remaining months instead of charging for the full interval.
details: Pro-rate billing when contract duration is shorter than billing interval (e.g. 13 months on biennial)
Pro-rate billing when contract ends mid-cycle for any interval
Applies to both regular and post-alignment billing events
Billing schedule shows pro-rate percentage alongside amounts

title: Transaction Match View for Banking
description: New slide-over panel to match bank transactions with invoices. Supports multi-invoice matching with running balance, difference calculation, and overbooking warnings.
details: Match panel opens from link icon on each transaction row in Banking and Counterparty pages
Shows all matched invoices with running total and color-coded difference (green/yellow/orange)
Search invoices by number with unmatched-only filter, click to add match
Overbooking warning when matched invoices exceed transaction by more than 3%
New backend queries: transactionMatchDetails and searchInvoicesForMatching

title: Fix Contract End Date Ignored in Billing and Forecast
description: Contracts with an end date in the past but database status still 'active' were incorrectly included in invoice generation and revenue forecast queries.
details: Exclude ended contracts from invoice generation service
Exclude ended contracts from both revenue forecast queries
Add early return guard in billing/recognition schedule when end_date clips range invalid

title: Pro-rate Dependent Items from Dependency ETA
description: Recurring items that depend on a pending deliverable now start billing from the dependency's ETA date with a pro-rated first period, instead of skipping to the next full billing cycle.
details: Compute dynamic alignment when dependency ETA pushes billing start past the contract alignment date
Generate pro-rated period from ETA to next cycle date, then full periods after
Fix applies to both billing and recognition forecast schedules

title: Revenue Forecast Performance Optimization
description: Eliminated N+1 database queries in the revenue and recognition forecast resolvers, significantly reducing load time.
details: Fix N+1 queries on payment_matches by using prefetched cache instead of .exists()
Use already-prefetched contract items instead of re-querying in exclude_one_off filter

title: Imported Invoice Lifecycle & Forecast Integration
description: Imported invoices now follow a full lifecycle (confirmed → sent → paid) and appear in the revenue forecast. Payment matches automatically transition invoices to paid.
details: Add sent and paid statuses to imported invoices
Confirmed imported invoices treated as sent for revenue forecast
Payment match creation transitions both imported and generated invoices to paid
Backfill 377 existing matched imported invoices to paid status
Add delivery delay hint to bulk invoice send result message

title: Fix Revenue Forecast Invoice Status Detection
description: Invoice status in the revenue forecast was always showing as yellow (actionable) because email delivery did not update the invoice status to sent.
details: Fix send_invoice_email task to set invoice status to sent after successful delivery
Forecast treats finalized invoices with email_sent_at as sent (handles existing data)

title: Invoice Navigation & Payment Details

details: Payment matches on invoice detail pages show booking text, reference, value date, and account name
Banking page invoice icon links to invoice detail page instead of contract/customer
Invoice numbers on customer detail and contract detail link to invoice detail page
Use Eye icon for PDF view action on customer invoice list
Fix S3 migration missing imported and generated invoice PDFs
Auto-run file storage migration on production startup

title: Revenue Forecast Invoice Status & Time Tracking Revenue/Hour

details: Revenue forecast cells color-coded by invoice lifecycle: pending (yellow), sent (blue), paid (green), overdue 60+ days (orange)
Invoice status applied to both billing and recognition forecast views
Color legend shown below forecast filter controls
Time tracking linked projects table shows revenue/hour when project is linked to a contract item
Revenue/hour calculated from item's current monthly price divided by tracked hours

title: Consistent German Number Formatting (de-DE)
description: All currency displays and inputs now use German number formatting (1.234,56 €) regardless of UI language.
details: Currency display uses de-DE locale consistently across all pages
New CurrencyInput component accepts comma as decimal separator
Shared formatCurrency, formatNumber, formatPercent, and parseGermanNumber utilities
Replaced 15+ local formatting function duplicates with shared imports
Currency input fields use text input with inputMode=decimal instead of type=number

Fix contract permissions and add ended-to-draft status transition

Show per-invoice errors (e.g. missing billing email) in a result banner after bulk send

Email notifications for HubSpot sync and time tracking sync tasks

Pin all backend dependencies to compatible release versions to prevent unexpected breakage

Fix ZUGFeRD arithmetic mismatch between line item net prices and totals
